title: Security gates, disclosure and repository governance
goal: Blocking dependency, license, SAST and secret gates; a correct disclosure policy proven by a reporter drill; rulesets and GitHub security settings applied, audited by script and proven by bypass drills.
context: Audit P0-A (A01), P0-D (A05), P1 A07. Owner D1 (0 approvals, no bypass), D6 (CODEOWNERS @academici), D7 (PVR on azguard-private), D16 (native secret scanning). P2.6 merges P1–P2 into main through the first ruleset-protected PR.

produces: Active rulesets and security settings with drill evidence
boundaries: packages/** only for a demonstrated defect
Settings only under gates GOVERNANCE-APPLY and SECURITY-DRILL

pitfalls: A live advisory fails the new gate at once: triage before enabling
A secret in history needs rotation, not an allowlist
A wrong required context blocks every merge
